items.title: A Complexity-Theoretic Approach to Proofs of Space
items.summary: A Proof of Space, PoS, as introduced by Dziembowski et al. [CRYPTO'15], is a two-phase protocol that enables a Prover to convince an efficient Verifier that it has allocated a large amount of persistent memory to storing some information. To our knowledge, all existing PoS protocols are only known to be secure in the random oracle model (or under ad hoc assumptions about cryptographic assumptions). We provide an elementary framework for constructing PoS from a combination of derandomization assumptions and cryptographic assumptions. We provide a few simple instantiations of the framework. We show that non-trivial PoS follow from (a) $\mathsf{E}=\mathsf{DTIME[2^{O(n)}]}$ is hard for exponential-size nondeterministic circuits (an assumption introduced to show $\mathsf{AM}=\mathsf{NP}$), and (b) collision-resistant hash functions. We also show that PoS with nearly optimal parameters and interaction pattern follows from assumption (a) above and (c) SNARGs for $\mathsf{P}$.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于计算复杂性理论构建空间证明（Proof of Space, PoS）的新框架。空间证明由 Dziembowski 等人在 CRYPTO'15 中引入，是一种两阶段协议，允许证明者向高效的验证者证明其已分配大量持久内存来存储某些信息。现有 PoS 协议大多仅在随机预言机模型（或基于临时性密码学假设）下被证明安全。作者旨在摆脱对随机预言机的依赖，转而结合去随机化假设与密码学假设，构建更可靠的安全基础。论文的核心贡献是一个基础性的通用框架，通过该框架可以实例化出多种 PoS 协议。具体而言，作者证明了：在假设 (a) E=DTIME[2^{O(n)}] 对指数规模的非确定性电路困难（该假设最初用于证明 AM=NP），以及 (b) 存在抗碰撞哈希函数的前提下，可以构造出非平凡的空间证明。此外，若进一步结合 (c) 针对 P 类问题的 SNARG（简洁非交互式论证），则可构造出参数近乎最优、交互模式更佳的空间证明。该工作从理论层面探索了 PoS 安全性的更广泛假设基础，为后续在标准模型下设计空间证明提供了新思路。适合理论密码学、计算复杂性理论以及区块链/去中心化存储等应用领域的研究者阅读，以了解 PoS 的安全假设演进与构造技术。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 空间证明是区块链和去中心化存储的重要原语，但现有方案安全证明依赖理想化模型。本文为在更基础的复杂性假设下构建 PoS 提供了理论路径，有助于提升实际系统的安全可信度，值得关注 PoS 底层安全性的研究者参考。

items.why_it_matters: 空间证明是区块链和去中心化存储的重要原语，但现有方案安全证明依赖理想化模型。本文为在更基础的复杂性假设下构建 PoS 提供了理论路径，有助于提升实际系统的安全可信度，值得关注 PoS 底层安全性的研究者参考。

items.title: From Noise to Meaning: Meaningful Secret Sharing with Tamper Detection for Facial Recognition
items.summary: Popularity of AI-based face recognition system directly demands protection of sensitive biometric data used for training. Visual secret sharing is an interesting idea, as it splits facial images into secret shares that look random and spread across many institutions. However, these shares look like noise and can easily spark suspicion and recognized as encrypted content. This makes them open to targeted collection and harvest-now-decrypt-later attacks. Additionally, visual secret sharing does not detect tampering, allowing attackers to modify shares and threaten the integrity of reconstruction. In this paper, we introduce a new method that turns distracting noise-like secret shares into visually appealing cover images with additional cryptographic tamper detection. The proposed technique works with visual secret sharing and introduces cover images to embed the shares using adaptive least significant bit steganography. Here, cover images with perceptual transparency are used to store secret shares while guaranteeing complete privacy. A two layer authentication using strong digital watermarking and cryptographic hashing is used to protect the integrity of shares. The proposed technique shows high resilience in stopping bit-flipping, cropping, and substitution attacks. Extensive experiments on multiple public face datasets show that the technique shows better FR accuracy, while eliminating share conspicuousness and guaranteeing integrity. The proposed framework sets a new standard for protecting facial data in such a way that privacy, security, and integrity are protected.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 随着基于AI的人脸识别系统广泛应用，用于训练的生物特征数据保护变得至关重要。视觉秘密共享（Visual Secret Sharing）将人脸图像拆分成看似随机噪声的份额，并可分散存储于多个机构，但这类份额作为噪声容易引起怀疑，被视为加密内容，从而可能遭受针对性收集及“先收集后解密”（harvest-now-decrypt-later）攻击。此外，传统视觉秘密共享无法检测篡改，攻击者可修改份额以破坏重构图像的完整性。针对上述问题，本文提出了一种新方法：通过自适应最低有效位（Adaptive LSB）隐写术，将原本类似噪声的密钥份额嵌入到具有视觉吸引力的封面图像中，在保证感知透明的同时完全隐藏秘密。该方法同时引入强数字水印和密码学哈希构成两层认证机制，以保护份额的完整性。实验表明，所提技术在多个公共人脸数据集上不仅对人脸识别（FR）准确率有所提升，而且彻底消除了份额的显眼性，并能够有效抵抗位翻转（bit-flipping）、裁剪（cropping）和替换（substitution）攻击。该框架将隐私性、安全性和完整性相结合，为面部数据的保护设立了新的标准，尤其适合需要跨机构安全协作的场景。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法将秘密分享的噪声份额伪装为自然图像，显著降低被识别和定向收集的风险，同时增加完整性校验能力，帮助蓝队在不暴露原始敏感数据的前提下进行分布式的安全存储与协作，值得安全从业者关注其应用和潜在扩展。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可用于任何需要跨机构共享敏感生物特征、医疗记录等数据的场景，提升隐蔽性和防篡改性；也可为联邦学习中的隐私保护提供参考。

items.title: Beyond Best Response: Quantal Stackelberg Deception as Insurance Against Attacker Misspecification
items.summary: Stackelberg Security Games (SSG) assume that an attacker observes the defender's strategy and chooses the target that maximizes their expected utility perfectly. In most realistic applications this is not plausible, and in the case of cyber deception (e.g., using decoys) the purpose of the game is to induce uncertainty and mistakes. Quantal response is a common way to represent noise and mistakes in decision-making; here it replaces perfect best-response with a logit choice with rationality parameter $λ$ and results in a generalized Quantal Stackelberg Equilibrium (QSE), which recovers the classical solution exactly as $λ\rightarrow \infty$. We conduct a deeper analysis of how QSE can function as a generalized form of insurance against a variety of forms of model specification error/uncertainty; our analysis shows that QSE provides a practical way to address the important role of tie-breaking rules and model uncertainty in SSG from both a theoretical and practical perspective. We conduct an empirical evaluation in a cybersecurity case study with two networks and real vulnerabilities drawn from CVE and scored using the Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS). QSE beats Stackelberg in realized defender utility spanning 144 scenarios with specification errors and 25 parameter configurations, with gains of 46\% to 175\% showing a substantial advantage in a wide variety of realistic cases.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究 Stackelberg 安全博弈（SSG）中的防守策略优化问题。传统 SSG 假设攻击者能完美观察防守者策略并精确选择最大化自身期望效用的目标，但在现实场景中，尤其当防守方使用蜜罐/诱饵等网络欺骗手段时，攻击者决策往往存在噪声和认知偏差。为此，作者引入量化响应（Quantal Response）模型，用 logit 选择函数替代完美最优响应，并通过理性参数 λ 控制噪声程度，形成广义的 Quantal Stackelberg 均衡（QSE）。当 λ 趋于无穷时，QSE 退化为经典均衡。论文从理论和实践两个层面论证 QSE 可作为一种抵御模型规格错误和不确定性的'保险'，尤其解决 SSG 中的平局打破规则和模型不确定性问题。实验部分基于 CVE 真实漏洞和 CVSS 评分，构建两个网络安全网络拓扑，在 144 个规格错误场景和 25 组参数配置下对比 QSE 与经典 Stackelberg 策略。结果显示，QSE 在防守者实际效用上全面优于经典方法，提升幅度达 46% 至 175%，表明其在多种现实情形下具有显著优势。该研究适合从事博弈论安全分析、网络欺骗与防御决策研究的学者及安全架构师阅读，可为防御资源分配和诱饵部署提供更鲁棒的决策依据。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 现实攻击者并非完美理性，传统 SSG 最优策略易被模型误差击穿。QSE 提供鲁棒性更强的防守方案，在安全博弈和欺骗防御场景下可显著提升防御效用，是理论到实践的重要衔接。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至网络欺骗、蜜罐部署、关键基础设防资源分配等场景，帮助安全团队在不确定威胁环境下制定更稳健的策略。

items.title: Treating Statewide CORS Networks as Spatially Distributed Sensors for GNSS Integrity Monitoring under Unintentional and Deliberate Threats
items.summary: State departments of transportation (DOTs) in the United States increasingly rely on statewide continuously operating reference station (CORS) networks to support high-precision Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-based positioning and timing for intelligent transportation systems. These networks also provide continuous observations that can support regional GNSS integrity monitoring. This study develops and demonstrates a framework that treats a statewide CORS network as a spatially distributed sensor system for identifying unintentional (environmental) and intentional (cyber) interference when GNSS measurements deviate from expected spatial patterns. We develop a graph-based Network Consistency Framework (NCF) that evaluates each station against its spatial neighborhood using four metrics: neighborhood residual, spatial gradient, residual, and graph smoothness. These metrics are combined into a Network Consistency Index (NCI). The framework is demonstrated using two consecutive days of four-constellation observations from 50 stations in the Alabama DOT-maintained CORS network, using changes in vertical total electron content (ΔVTEC) and the Rate of TEC Index (ROTI) as spatially coherent observables. The framework quantified network-wide spatial consistency and identified localized anomalies. Detected anomalies indicate stations whose observations deviated from the surrounding regional network, signaling potential integrity issues. Determining whether anomalies result from receiver faults, localized interference, spoofing, or other causes requires further investigation. This study introduces statewide CORS networks as regional GNSS integrity observatories and presents the NCF and NCI for graph-based spatial integrity monitoring. Transportation agencies can implement the framework using existing CORS observations to monitor network integrity and identify localized anomalies.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对美国各州交通部门（DOT）越来越依赖全州连续运行参考站（CORS）网络来支持智能交通系统所需的高精度GNSS定位与授时这一背景，提出利用该网络作为空间分布式传感器，以识别无意（环境）和故意（网络）干扰。由于GNSS测量在受到干扰时会偏离预期空间模式，作者设计了一个基于图的网络一致性框架（NCF），对每个站点与其空间邻域进行比较，采用邻域残差、空间梯度、残差和图平滑度四个度量，并结合为网络一致性指数（NCI）。该框架使用阿拉巴马州DOT维护的50个CORS站点、连续两天的四星座观测数据进行演示，以垂直总电子含量变化（ΔVTEC）和TEC变化率指数（ROTI）作为空间相干可观测值。实验表明，框架能够量化全网空间一致性并识别出局部异常站点，这些站点的观测值偏离了周边区域网络，提示潜在完整性问题。但异常的具体原因（接收机故障、局部干扰、欺骗等）需要进一步调查。本研究的主要贡献是将全州CORS网络引入作为区域GNSS完整性观测平台，并提出了NCF和NCI用于基于图的空间完整性监测。交通机构可直接利用现有CORS观测实施该框架，以增强对网络完整性的持续监测和局部异常发现。该工作为GNSS完好性监测提供了新的思路，尤其适用于关键基础设施中的位置服务保障。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: GNSS欺骗和干扰是日益严峻的网络物理威胁。该研究利用现有交通CORS网络实现对局部干扰的自动检测，为关键基础设施的GNSS完整性监测提供了低成本、可部署的技术路径，值得安全从业者关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面：适用于所有依赖CORS网络的高精度定位服务，可扩展至其他空间分布的传感器网络异常检测；对智能交通、电力授时等关键基础设施有借鉴意义。
detection_signals_zh: 站点NCI与其邻域统计特性显著差异
defense_advice_zh: 将NCF/NCI框架集成到现有CORS网络监测平台，实时计算空间一致性指标
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估在自有CORS网络上的可行性

items.title: Toward Metacognitive One-Shot Indirect Prompt Injection: Strategy Abstraction Via Outcome-Conditioned Reflection
items.summary: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection (IPI), in which malicious instructions embedded in external observations manipulate subsequent agent decisions and actions. Most existing adaptive attacks rely on repeatedly querying and refining against the target agent, whereas realistic attackers may have only a single opportunity to interact with an unknown target agent. We propose SAVOR (Strategy Abstraction Via Outcome-Conditioned Reflection), which shifts attack adaptation from test-time iteration to offline strategy distillation. SAVOR performs outcome-conditioned reflection over successful and failed trajectories collected from disjoint training environments, validates context-conditioned candidate strategies, and iteratively consolidates them into a reusable strategy memory. At test time, the frozen memory guides the generation of a single payload for each unseen target, requiring only one target-agent query and no target-agent feedback. Across two benchmarks and three victim models, SAVOR attains the highest average attack success rate in all six settings, leading the strongest prior attack by 2.5 to 11.8 points and the same injection channel without strategy learning by 23.1 points on Agent Security Bench, which holds out attacker tools, and 28.6 points on OpenClaw-IPI, an executable benchmark we introduce that holds out attack goals and verifies attacks through tool interactions and execution receipts. A memory learned under one defense also transfers to another.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了工具使用型大型语言模型（LLM）智能体面临的间接提示注入（Indirect Prompt Injection, IPI）安全威胁。IPI 攻击是指攻击者将恶意指令嵌入到外部观察数据（如网页、文档、工具返回结果）中，使智能体在不知情的情况下执行非预期操作。已有自适应攻击大多依赖在测试阶段反复查询目标智能体并根据反馈迭代优化攻击负载，但现实场景中攻击者往往只有一次交互机会，且目标智能体通常是未知的。为此，作者提出了 SAVOR（Strategy Abstraction Via Outcome-Conditioned Reflection）框架，将攻击适应性从测试时迭代转变为离线策略蒸馏：先在相互分离的训练环境中收集成功与失败的攻击轨迹，通过基于结果条件的反思（outcome-conditioned reflection）提取出上下文相关的候选策略，再对这些策略进行验证并逐步合并为可复用的策略记忆。在测试阶段，冻结的策略记忆指导生成针对每个未见目标的单一攻击负载，整个过程只需一次目标智能体查询，且不需要任何目标反馈。作者在两个基准和三个受害模型上进行了评估，SAVOR 在所有六种设置中均达到最高平均攻击成功率，相比最强的先前提案提升 2.5 到 11.8 个百分点，并大幅超过不使用策略学习的同通道注入方法。作者还引入了 OpenClaw-IPI 基准，该基准通过工具交互和执行收据验证攻击有效性，并预留攻击目标以测试泛化性。实验表明，在一种防御下学习的策略记忆可以迁移到另一种防御。该研究揭示了离线策略蒸馏在一次性 IPI 攻击中的高效性，对智能体安全防御提出了新的挑战。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究展示了一种仅需一次查询即可高效实施间接提示注入的攻击范式，突破了传统自适应攻击对多次交互的依赖，对 LLM 智能体安全评估与防御具有重要警示意义。

items.title: HaloMark: A Spectral Threshold for Embedding-Vector Watermarking under C2PA
items.summary: Foundation-model embeddings are now a primary data asset, but the content-provenance machinery built for images and audio does not transfer to them. C2PA binds to an asset with a stable bit-level or perceptual identity; embeddings have neither, since quantisation, projection, fine-tuning, and windowed averaging reshape them in normal use and break any fixed hash. We present HaloMark, a watermark for embedding vectors cryptographically bound to a C2PA manifest. It composes four standard primitives -- a block-diagonal orthogonal rotation, public whitening, an input-dependent LSH commitment, and a per-vector nonce -- around one protocol change: the producer signs the LSH commitment c into the C2PA sidecar, and the verifier reads c from the manifest instead of recomputing it. Recomputing is fragile under whitening, which flips the commitment bucket on 62% of inputs at cos = 0.96; reading the signed c reduces the verifier's score to T = T_null + beta(A)*epsilon, so security turns on a single scalar beta, which we bound rigorously for linear and non-adaptive attackers and characterise empirically for the adaptive case. We evaluate against an adversary holding polynomially many clean/watermarked pairs under one key with full sidecar visibility, across eight baselines and ten adaptive attackers including denoising-autoencoder removal. The eleven encoders separate at an empirical threshold eff_rank(Sigma)/d ~= 0.19: above it, detection AUROC stays at 0.98 or higher across every in-budget attack on the three encoders we sweep in full, and at 0.965 or higher under single-seed DAE removal on the rest; below it every variant we tested fails. Why the threshold is dimension-uniform is left open. Deployed as a Qdrant admission filter, the verifier runs at 284 us and 24 bytes of sidecar per vector, validated end-to-end against three C2PA reference-SDK bindings.

llm_summary.summary_zh: HaloMark 提出了一种面向基础模型 embedding 向量的水印方案，并使其与 C2PA 内容溯源标准绑定。由于 embedding 在量化、投影、微调和窗口平均等常规操作下会改变数值，无法像图像或音频那样使用稳定的位级或感知哈希进行绑定，因此现有 C2PA 机制无法直接迁移。HaloMark 的核心思路是将四个标准原语组合：块对角正交旋转、公开白化、输入相关的 LSH 承诺和每向量随机数，并引入一个关键协议变化：生产者将 LSH 承诺 c 签名进 C2PA 侧车（sidecar），验证者直接从清单中读取 c 而不是重新计算。重新计算在白化后非常脆弱，在 cos=0.96 时会导致 62% 的输入翻转承诺桶；而读取已签名的 c 可将验证得分简化为 T = T_null + beta(A)*epsilon，安全强度归结为单个标量 beta。作者对线性和非自适应攻击者给出了严格的 beta 上界，并自适应场景进行了实证刻画。评估中考虑了拥有单密钥下多项式级别干净/水印配对、可完全查看侧车的攻击者，覆盖八个基线和十个自适应攻击者，包括去噪自编码器移除攻击。实验发现 11 个编码器在经验阈值 eff_rank(Sigma)/d ≈ 0.19 处出现分界：高于该阈值时，在三个完整扫描的编码器上所有预算内攻击的检测 AUROC 不低于 0.98，其余编码器上单种子 DAE 移除攻击下 AUROC 不低于 0.965；低于该阈值时所有测试变体均失败。该阈值的维度均匀性原因仍属开放问题。在 Qdrant 准入过滤器部署中，验证器运行时间为 284 微秒，每个向量仅需 24 字节侧车数据，并已针对三个 C2PA 参考 SDK 绑定完成端到端验证。该研究适合关注 AI 数据资产溯源、模型水印、内容真实性校验的研究人员与蓝队工程师阅读，为 embedding 资产保护提供了一种可落地的密码学与机器学习交叉方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: embedding 已成为核心数据资产，但现有溯源机制无法适用。HaloMark 首次将 C2PA 绑定到向量级水印，为 AI 资产溯源和篡改检测提供了可量化安全边界的基准方案，对依赖 embedding 的检索增强生成、向量数据库场景有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至 AI 数据资产溯源、向量数据库准入控制、模型泄露追踪、RAG 系统内容验证等场景；验证器开销低（284us/向量，24B 侧边信息），便于集成到现有 MLOps 管道。

items.title: Whose Refusal Is It? The Unmeasured Contribution of Black-Box Multimodal Guardrails
items.summary: A black-box guardrail is evaluated as though the safety number it earns were its own. It is not. A defended pipeline holds two components that can refuse (the guardrail, and the target model out of its own alignment), and every reported metric is a sum over both. We show that the guardrail's actual share of the safety credited to it runs from none of it to essentially all of it, decided by two variables no evaluation records: which channel carries the payload, and what text the harness places in the defense's internal read. The split is recoverable at no extra cost, because a guard block replaces the model's response and the two counts are therefore disjoint. On a text guard across two open-weight targets: with the payload rendered as pixels the guard blocks nothing and the model produces every refusal the system makes; reading the encoded prompt the attacker actually sent, the guard produces a minority of the refusals attributed to it; reading the unencoded request behind the attack, it blocks almost everything and the model falls silent. The blindness is not inaccuracy: the same guards block no benign image inputs either, so their image-channel decision is a constant. Granting the unencoded request inflates measured benefit substantially for a guard gate, less for a caption-mediated re-check, and not at all for a majority-vote smoother; the ordering reproduces in an independent replicate. Isolating the grant within one defense shows it does not improve detection: the harm-verdict stage contributes nothing, while the stage that regenerates the answer carries the effect. Nor is the inflated setting careless; the reference implementation builds every stage from a single prompt field that cannot distinguish what the attacker sent from what the benchmark records, so faithful porting supplies it silently. Previously published figures of our own are among those revised.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对黑盒多模态护栏（guardrail）在安全评估中的指标归属偏差问题展开研究。通常，一个包含护栏的防御流水线会被整体评估，其报告的安全分数被默认视为护栏自身的贡献，但由于被保护的目标模型本身也具备对齐能力，实际拒绝可能来自两者之和。作者通过受控实验证明，护栏被归功的拒绝量可以介于零到全部之间，而决定因素恰恰是评估记录中未记录的两个变量：载荷的传输通道（文本还是像素）以及测试框架在护栏内部读取的文本内容。由于拒绝响应与护栏拦截在计数上互斥，研究者可以无额外成本地拆分两类拒绝来源。实验使用文本护栏和两个开源权重目标模型进行验证：当载荷以像素形式呈现时，护栏完全不拦截，全部拒绝都来自目标模型；当护栏读取到攻击者实际发送的编码提示时，只有少数拒绝可归因于护栏；当读取到攻击背后的未编码原始请求时，护栏拦截了几乎全部攻击，模型自身则几乎没有拒绝。这种失效并非检测不准确，而是图像通道的决策近乎常值。此外，论文测试了三种护栏集成方式（门控、字幕中介复检、多数投票平滑）在将未编码请求作为护栏输入时，其测量收益的提升程度各不相同：门控提升最大，复检次之，多数投票无提升，且结果在独立复制实验中重现。进一步在单一护栏内部隔离该输入设定后，发现它并不改善真正的检测能力：危害判定阶段无贡献，而重新生成答案的阶段承担了全部效果。作者还指出，该设定并非粗心所致，参考实现的所有阶段共用一个提示字段，无法区分攻击者原始载荷与基准记录内容，因此忠实移植会静默引入该偏差。论文最后修订了此前公开的若干实验结果。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 安全评估中护栏的真实贡献常被系统性高估，该研究揭示了评估方法中的隐性配置如何扭曲安全指标，对依赖黑盒护栏告警的蓝队有直接警示意义，提醒其关注护栏与模型自身拒绝的边界。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响多模态安全护栏的评估流程、开源基准测试设计，以及部署LLM防护流水线的组织对安全有效性的判断。

items.title: Robust Reputation-Driven Crowdsourced Federated Learning
items.summary: Crowdsourced Federated Learning (CrowdFL) extends traditional federated learning by enabling open and heterogeneous participation through a crowdsourcing paradigm. In this setting, reputation-driven incentive mechanisms are commonly employed to guide worker selection and enhance trustworthiness. While such approaches improve participant reliability, existing frameworks largely overlook the quantification of their robustness against stealthy adversaries, particularly those capable of evading standard detection mechanisms. To fill this gap, this paper proposes R2CFL, a robust reputation-driven CrowdFL framework. R2CFL introduces a robust reputation model coupled with a nearest neighbor mixing (R2-NNM) defense mechanism that links reputation evolution with the filtering of updates during aggregation. The proposed mechanism prevents stealthy attackers from gradually accumulating trust and influencing future tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that R2-NNM matches or surpasses state-of-the-art Byzantine-robust and backdoor defense mechanisms against adaptive attackers. Furthermore, when integrated with existing detect-and-filter defenses, the proposed reputation model faithfully captures the statistical robustness of the underlying defense by producing reputation scores that closely reflect its true positive and false positive characteristics.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对众包联邦学习（Crowdsourced Federated Learning, CrowdFL）中的鲁棒性问题展开研究。CrowdFL 通过众包范式允许开放和异构的参与者加入联邦学习，但这也引入了恶意或不可靠的参与者。现有工作通常使用基于声誉的激励机制来选择工人并提升可信度，但大多未系统评估该机制在对抗隐蔽攻击者（特别是能够规避标准检测的对手）时的鲁棒性。为填补这一空白，作者提出 R2CFL 框架，其核心是一个鲁棒声誉模型（R2）与最近邻混合防御机制（R2-NNM）。该机制将声誉动态与聚合时的更新过滤相结合，防止隐蔽攻击者逐步累积信任并影响后续任务。实验表明，R2-NNM 在抵御自适应攻击者方面，能达到或超过现有最先进的拜占庭鲁棒与后门防御方法。此外，当与已有的检测-过滤防御集成时，所提声誉模型能够忠实反映底层防御的统计鲁棒性，其产生的声誉分数与防御的真实阳性率和假阳性率高度一致。该工作的主要贡献包括：首次系统性地将声誉机制与最近邻混合防御结合以应对渐进式信任攻击；提出一种可解释且可迁移的声誉度量方法；通过实验验证了该框架在多种攻击场景下的有效性。适合关注联邦学习安全、鲁棒聚合机制设计以及声誉系统可靠性的研究人员和安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 联邦学习中的隐蔽攻击者可通过逐步累积信任绕过基于声誉的防御，R2CFL 提供了一种将声誉演化与更新过滤深度融合的防御思路，对设计更鲁棒的众包学习系统具有直接指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至任何采用声誉机制的协作式机器学习平台，特别是开放参与场景下的数据聚合与节点筛选。

items.title: IoXT: The Internet of Explainable Things. Why Explainability in IoT Requires a New System-Level Paradigm and Protocol Design
items.summary: The Internet of Things (IoT) increasingly combines sensing, communication, artificial intelligence (AI), decision-making, and actuation. In many domains, sensor observations are processed by edge or cloud intelligence to select actions that configure or control actuators; where actuation changes the environment, later observations may also be affected. Existing explainable AI (XAI) methods can explain model predictions, but they do not by themselves explain the end-to-end path from sensed evidence to physical action. This paper introduces the Internet of Explainable Things (IoXT), a system-level paradigm that makes explainability an architectural property of intelligent IoT. Its novelty is explainability-by-design across the sensing-communication-intelligence-decision-actuation path. IoXT derives requirements and design principles for identity and addressability, temporal fidelity, cross-layer provenance, bidirectional traceability, streaming and incident-time evidence, protocol-semantic continuity, security and privacy, lifecycle continuity, and conformance. We formalize timestamped provenance graphs, sensor participation, trace completeness, cross-layer coverage, reconstruction latency, and No Orphan Actuation: a consequential action must remain traceable to the authorizing decision and source evidence, or be explicitly marked degraded or non-conformant. IoXT prescribes neither a particular XAI method nor a wire protocol. Instead, it defines the conditions under which model explanations remain connected to real sensor inputs, communication history, decisions, actuator execution, and outcomes. Explainability Telemetry Protocols (XTPs) are introduced as a protocol category for preserving these semantics across heterogeneous IoT systems, together with IoXT-ready and IoXT-conformant assurance concepts.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出“可解释之物互联网（IoXT）”这一系统级范式，旨在解决智能物联网（IoT）中可解释性缺失的端到端问题。传统物联网将传感、通信、AI决策与执行结合，但现有可解释AI（XAI）方法仅能解释模型预测，无法说明从感知证据到物理动作的完整链路。IoXT的核心创新在于“基于设计的可解释性”（explainability-by-design），将可解释性作为智能物联网的架构属性，贯穿感知-通信-智能-决策-执行全过程。论文从身份与可寻址性、时间保真度、跨层溯源、双向可追溯性、流式与事件时刻证据、协议语义连续性、安全与隐私、生命周期连续性、一致性等方面推导出需求与设计原则。形式化定义了带时间戳的溯源图、传感器参与度、痕迹完整性、跨层覆盖、重建延迟等指标，并提出“无孤儿执行（No Orphan Actuation）”原则：任何实际动作必须能追溯到授权决策和源证据，否则必须明确标记为降级或不符合。IoXT不规定具体XAI方法或通信协议，而是定义模型解释与真实传感器输入、通信历史、决策、执行器行为及结果保持关联的条件。论文引入“可解释性遥测协议（XTP）”作为协议类别，用于在异构IoT系统中保留上述语义，并提出IoXT-ready和IoXT-conformant两类保证概念。该工作适合从事物联网安全、AI可解释性、系统架构设计的研究人员及希望构建可审计智能系统的工程团队阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 物联网中AI决策直接影响物理世界，若无法解释感知到动作的链路，安全事故难以溯源。该范式为构建可审计、可追溯的智能IoT系统提供了系统级设计框架，对安全合规和事件调查具有重要参考价值。

items.title: A Combined Feature-Based Framework for Disguise and Spoofing Detection in Face Recognition Systems
items.summary: Face recognition systems face two distinct, commonly-separated failure modes: spoofing, where an impostor presents a photograph or video of an authorized user, and disguise, where a legitimate user is rejected because their appearance differs from their enrolled template due to accessories, facial hair, illumination, or pose. This paper proposes and compares five combined feature-extraction and classification pipelines that address both problems within a single framework: PM (PCA and Minimum Euclidean Distance, MED), LPM (Local Binary Patterns with PCA and MED), HPM (Histogram of Oriented Gradients with PCA and MED), SM (Speeded-Up Robust Features with MED), and HM (Harris corner features with MED). Each pipeline follows a common two-phase process comprising pre-processing, feature extraction, feature filtering, and classification. The methods were trained on 115 subjects drawn from the FEI, Disguised Faces Database, and NUAA databases and evaluated on six test conditions covering mixed appearances, frontal faces, dark illumination, left- and right-turned poses, and photo-spoofing attempts. The HOG-based pipeline (HPM) achieved the most consistent performance across conditions, with 94.59% accuracy on mixed-appearance disguise, 81.5-93.2% across pose and illumination variants, and 91.67% on spoofing, while the LBP-based pipeline (LPM) achieved the highest spoofing-detection accuracy (93.2%) but weaker robustness to pose change. These results reveal a measurable trade-off between spoof sensitivity and disguise robustness among classical feature representations, motivating the deep-learning and cross-database extensions discussed in the concluding sections.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对人脸识别系统面临的两类常见但通常被分开处理的失败模式——欺骗攻击和伪装变化——提出并比较了五种结合特征提取与分类的流水线框架。欺骗攻击指冒名者使用授权用户的照片或视频尝试通过认证；伪装变化指合法用户因配饰、胡须、光照或姿态等外观变化而被系统拒绝。作者在一个统一框架内同时解决这两个问题，设计了五种流水线：PM（基于主成分分析 PCA 与最小欧氏距离分类器 MED）、LPM（局部二值模式 LBP + PCA + MED）、HPM（方向梯度直方图 HOG + PCA + MED）、SM（加速稳健特征 SURF + MED）以及 HM（Harris 角点特征 + MED）。每条流水线均遵循两阶段流程：预处理、特征提取、特征筛选和分类。实验基于 FEI、Disguised Faces Database 和 NUAA 三个数据集的 115 名被试进行训练，并在六种测试条件下评估：混合外观伪装、正面人脸、暗光照、左/右转身姿态以及照片欺骗尝试。结果显示，基于 HOG 的流水线 HPM 在各类条件下表现最稳定：混合外观伪装准确率达 94.59%，姿态与光照变化下为 81.5%-93.2%，欺骗检测准确率 91.67%；而基于 LBP 的流水线 LPM 在欺骗检测上达到最高准确率 93.2%，但对姿态变化的鲁棒性较弱。这些结果揭示了经典特征表示在欺骗敏感性与伪装鲁棒性之间存在可量化的权衡，为后续讨论的深度学习扩展和跨数据库扩展提供了动机。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究将人脸识别中常被分离的欺骗检测与伪装鲁棒性问题统一到单一框架，揭示了经典特征在此任务中的性能权衡，对设计更可靠的人脸认证系统具有参考价值，尤其适合关注生物识别对抗鲁棒性的蓝队人员。

items.title: SkillsMetric: Mapping the Detection Boundary of Static Analysis for Malicious Agent Skills
items.summary: Agent Skills---structured packages of instructions and scripts that augment LLM-based agents---are rapidly proliferating, yet their security properties remain under-explored. We present \textsc{SkillsMetric}, a five-stage static analysis framework that scores skill packages along pattern density, statistical anomaly, dataflow taint, import anomaly, and capability mismatch dimensions. We construct an adversarial evaluation dataset of 2{,}266 skills spanning 16~attack types across code-level, system-level, and semantic-level threats, and evaluate on the full SkillMD-138K corpus. Our framework achieves an AUC of 0.93 and 5-fold cross-validated F1 of 73.4\%$\pm$0.5\%, with strong detection of data exfiltration (93\%) and steganographic payloads (93\%). Crucially, we identify fundamental blind spots: \emph{host destruction} attacks using common shell commands evade all five stages (0\% detection), and \emph{prompt injection} via natural-language manipulation achieves only 42\% detection. These findings establish that static analysis alone is insufficient for skill security, motivating defense-in-depth architectures that combine fast static pre-screening with semantic review.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦于 LLM 代理生态中快速增长的 Agent Skills（结构化指令与脚本包）的安全性问题。尽管这类技能包正被广泛采用，其安全属性却严重缺乏系统研究。作者提出 SkillsMetric，一个五阶段静态分析框架，用于对技能包进行恶意性评分。框架沿着五个维度进行检测：模式密度（即恶意指令的常见模式出现频率）、统计异常（与正常技能语料库的统计偏差）、数据流污点（追踪敏感数据流向）、导入异常（检测可疑的模块或库引用）以及能力不匹配（评估技能声称功能与实际行为之间的差异）。为验证框架，作者构建了一个对抗性评估数据集，包含 2,266 个恶意技能，涵盖 16 种攻击类型，并分为代码级、系统级和语义级威胁三大类；同时在完整的 SkillMD-138K 语料库上进行评估。实验结果显示，SkillsMetric 的 AUC 达到 0.93，5 折交叉验证的 F1 得分为 73.4%±0.5%，对数据外泄攻击和隐写载荷的检测率均高达 93%。然而，关键盲点也被明确识别：使用常见 shell 命令的主机破坏攻击能够逃避所有五个检测阶段（检测率为 0%），而通过自然语言操纵实现的提示注入检测率仅为 42%。这些发现有力证明，仅靠静态分析无法充分保障 Agent Skills 的安全，必须采用深度防御架构，将快速静态预筛查与语义审查相结合。该研究为 Agent 安全领域提供了首个针对恶意技能的静态分析基准，并明确指出了现有方法的边界。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Agent Skills 正成为 LLM 代理的核心组件，但恶意技能包可能被投放到插件市场或供应链中。本文系统评估了静态分析的检测极限，揭示了主机破坏与提示注入的盲区，为蓝队设计多层防御提供了实证依据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面涵盖基于 LLM 的代理平台、技能插件市场、自动化安全工具等。其检测思路可迁移到恶意代码分析、供应链安全评估等场景，尤其对构建 Agent 安全审查流程具有参考价值。
detection_signals_zh: 模式密度异常（恶意指令常见模式出现频率过高）
统计异常（与正常技能语料库的显著统计偏差）
数据流污染（敏感数据流向可疑目标）
导入异常（引用可疑或不受信任的库/模块）
能力不匹配（技能声明功能与实际行为不一致）
defense_advice_zh: 对 Agent Skills 采用静态预筛查与人工语义审查结合的深度防御架构
对涉及系统级操作（如 shell 命令）的技能实施额外沙箱或权限隔离
重点监控通过自然语言注入诱导代理行为的技能，并加强运行时行为检测

items.title: What Keeps Agent Skills from Being Reusable? Evidence from 138K SKILL.md Files
items.summary: Under the current standard, Agent Skills are SKILL.md files that combine instructions with supporting resources, enabling Large Language Model (LLM) agents to reuse procedures beyond a single conversation. Yet many public skills appear to originate from a single task, repository, or conversation, even when they are shared as reusable components. We analyze this gap across 138,133 public SKILL.md files from 20,556 repositories using a two-tier defect taxonomy grounded in the official specification and best-practice guidance. We find that 91.8% of skills contain at least one detected defect, with stable estimates across lenient and strict thresholds (88.8-94.6%). The dominant failures are ordinary packaging problems rather than exotic attacks: weak routing metadata, bloated or non-actionable bodies, and poor resource organization. A deterministic routing stress test over 20,000 skills shows the functional impact: skills with valid routing metadata are retrieved more reliably from startup descriptions than skills with routing defects. Defect rates vary by platform and provenance: specification-aware skills contain fewer defects, while AI-marked skills show more safety and portability problems. Lightweight enforcement and repair experiments support a quality-assured generation workflow combining spec-aware prompting, lightweight linting, automated repair, and safety gating.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对当前 LLM 代理生态中“Agent Skills”（即以 SKILL.md 文件为核心、结合指令与辅助资源、使 LLM 代理可跨对话复用技能的标准格式）的可重用性问题进行了大规模实证研究。研究动机在于：尽管大量 SKILL.md 文件被公开共享并被标榜为可复用组件，但许多技能实际仅源自单个任务、单个代码仓库或单个对话，缺乏真正的通用性。作者从 20,556 个公开仓库中收集了 138,133 个 SKILL.md 文件，基于官方规范和最佳实践定义了一个双层缺陷分类体系，并对其进行了系统分析。结果显示，高达 91.8% 的技能至少包含一个已识别缺陷，且在宽松和严格两种判定阈值下结果稳定（88.8%–94.6%）。研究发现，最普遍的缺陷并非恶意攻击或高级漏洞，而是常见的打包和描述问题：路由元数据（如名称、描述、触发条件）不充分、技能正文臃肿或缺乏可操作性、资源文件组织混乱等。为了量化这些缺陷的功能影响，作者对 20,000 个技能进行了确定性路由压力测试，证明与具有有效路由元数据的技能相比，存在路由缺陷的技能更难被代理从启动描述中准确检索和调用。此外，缺陷率还与技能的平台来源和生成方式相关：遵循规范生成的技能缺陷更少，而由 AI 生成或标注的技能在安全性和可移植性方面问题更多。最后，作者通过轻量级执行和修复实验，验证了一种结合规范感知提示、轻量级 linting、自动修复和安全门控的质量保证生成工作流，能够显著降低缺陷率。该研究为 Agent Skills 的开发者、平台设计者和安全工程师提供了大规模数据支撑，揭示了技能可重用性危机的根源，并提出了实际可行的质量提升路径。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Agent Skills 的可重用性直接关系到 LLM 代理执行任务时的安全与可靠性。大规模存在的打包缺陷可能导致技能被错误路由、资源被滥用或产生意外行为，安全团队需要意识到技能供应链中的系统性风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响 LLM 代理生态中所有依赖公共技能库的开发者与平台；缺陷模式可迁移至技能审计、质量门禁和供应链安全检测场景。
detection_signals_zh: SKILL.md 缺少或弱化 name/description 等路由元数据
技能正文过长或包含大量不可执行的叙事内容
资源文件引用混乱或缺失声明
AI 生成标记的技能表现出更高的安全与可移植性风险
defense_advice_zh: 在技能入库前执行规范感知的元数据校验
采用轻量级 linting 工具自动检查技能结构与路由字段
对技能资源进行依赖和安全审查，避免引入不可信内容
结合安全门控流程，对 AI 生成的技能额外验证可移植性和安全性

items.title: Differential Privacy for Markov Chain State Trajectories
items.summary: Data-driven systems may require state trajectories of Markov chains to function because these trajectories contain information that is useful to the system, e.g., a product's credit risk, a user's physical location, or a user's internet browsing behavior. However, sharing such state trajectories can reveal sensitive information about users, which presents a privacy threat. Therefore, we develop a new framework for privatizing the state trajectories in a Markov chain using differential privacy. Our framework privatizes state trajectories online, in the sense that a private state trajectory is generated at the same time as the sensitive one it approximates. We treat Markov chains as weighted directed graphs whose edge weights are the negative logarithms of the transition probabilities. Then, each state in a private state trajectory is chosen by minimizing its distance to the corresponding state in the sensitive state trajectory, where the notion of distance is equal to the total edge weight along a shortest path. We prove that with high probability the private state trajectory remains close to the sensitive one, which maintains high utility for downstream uses of private data. Additionally, we prove that private state trajectories are consistently in the typical set of state trajectories generated by the underlying Markov chain, which means that private state trajectories have similar statistical properties to actual state trajectories produced by the underlying Markov chain. Numerical simulations show that under $3$-differential privacy, the mechanism we introduce exhibits up to an $80\%$ decrease in entropy compared to the state of the art, which illustrates that private state trajectories generated by our framework more closely resemble their corresponding sensitive state trajectory while maintaining the same level of privacy.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究的是马尔可夫链状态轨迹的隐私保护问题。在许多数据驱动系统中，系统功能依赖于用户或实体的状态轨迹，例如产品信用风险、用户物理位置或上网行为等。然而，共享这些状态轨迹可能泄露用户的敏感信息。为此，作者提出了一种基于差分隐私的新框架，用于在线私有化马尔可夫链的状态轨迹。所谓在线是指私有轨迹与敏感轨迹同步生成，而非事后处理。该框架将马尔可夫链建模为加权有向图，边的权重为转移概率的负对数。生成私有轨迹时，每个私有状态通过最小化与敏感状态之间的最短路径总边权距离来选择。作者证明，以高概率私有轨迹保持接近敏感轨迹，从而保证下游数据使用的高效用。此外，他们还证明私有轨迹始终处于底层马尔可夫链生成的状态轨迹的典型集合中，意味着私有轨迹与真实轨迹具有相似的统计特性。数值模拟表明，在 3-差分隐私下，与现有技术相比，所提机制在熵上最多可降低 80%，说明生成的私有轨迹在保持相同隐私水平的同时，更接近对应的敏感轨迹。该工作为马尔可夫链轨迹数据发布提供了一种理论保证的隐私保护方法，适合研究数据隐私、随机过程及应用密码学的学者和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 马尔可夫链轨迹广泛存在于位置服务、信用评估等场景，直接共享会泄露用户隐私。本文提出的在线私有化框架能在保证差分隐私的同时显著提升轨迹可用性，为蓝队设计隐私保护的数据共享方案提供了新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于任何涉及马尔可夫链状态序列共享的隐私保护场景，如移动用户轨迹发布、网页浏览记录脱敏、金融信用状态转移数据分享等。

items.why_it_matters: 马尔可夫链轨迹广泛存在于位置服务、信用评估等场景，直接共享会泄露用户隐私。本文提出的在线私有化框架能在保证差分隐私的同时显著提升轨迹可用性，为蓝队设计隐私保护的数据共享方案提供了新思路。

items.title: Privacy-Preserving Data Drift Detection and Recovery for Large-Scale LLM Applications via Proxy Representations
items.summary: LLM applications deployed at scale face a fundamental challenge: privacy constraints prevent direct inspection of user interactions, making it difficult to obtain any representative evaluation dataset or to track the ongoing evolution of production traffic. We present ProxyDrift, a framework that (i) identifies and measures drift between production traffic and offline evaluation sets, and (ii) constructs and refreshes those evaluation sets accordingly; all without access to raw user data. Our approach operates entirely on non-PII proxy representations: structured, multi-dimensional descriptors derived from LLM-based classification of user interactions. We introduce (1) a chance-calibrated, redundancy-aware (RA) alignment score that aggregates per-dimension drift measurements via mutual information; (2) a conditional sampler that generates synthetic proxies respecting inter-dimensional dependencies; (3) a roundtrip consistency analysis that exposes generator/classifier disagreements and guides proxy taxonomy refinement; and (4) a feedback-linkage analysis that ties per-dimension and per-value proxy distributions to user satisfaction, surfacing actionable failure and success modes. Serving hundreds of millions of users, ProxyDrift enables continuous drift monitoring and targeted synthetic data generation without exposing sensitive user data. Experiments confirm strong roundtrip consistency, discriminator-level indistinguishability of synthetic queries from human queries, and tight end-to-end alignment (RA~0.9) with production.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 ProxyDrift 框架，用于在大规模 LLM 应用中实现隐私保护的数据漂移检测与评估集恢复。核心问题在于：生产环境中用户交互数据包含敏感信息，直接查看原始数据违反隐私约束，导致无法获得代表性评估集，也难以追踪生产流量的持续演化。ProxyDrift 完全基于非 PII 的代理表示（proxy representations）运作，即通过 LLM 对用户交互进行分类得到的结构化、多维度描述符，避免接触原始用户数据。框架包含四个关键组件：(1) 机会校准且冗余感知（RA）的对齐分数，利用互信息聚合各维度漂移测量，判断生产流量与离线评估集之间的分布差异；(2) 条件采样器，生成尊重维度间依赖关系的合成代理样本，用于动态刷新评估集；(3) 往返一致性分析，揭示生成器与分类器之间的分歧，指导代理分类法的迭代优化；(4) 反馈关联分析，将各维度及取值对应的代理分布与用户满意度关联，暴露可操作的失败与成功模式。该系统服务数亿用户，实现了持续漂移监控和定向合成数据生成，同时不泄露敏感用户数据。实验表明，合成查询与人类查询在判别器层面几乎不可区分，往返一致性良好，端到端对齐分数（RA~0.9）与生产数据紧密匹配。该研究适合 LLM 应用运维工程师、隐私保护机器学习研究者以及关注数据漂移检测与评估集维护的安全从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文解决了 LLM 生产环境中隐私与可观测性之间的矛盾，提供了一套无需访问原始数据即可检测漂移并更新评估集的方法，对构建合规且可靠的大型 LLM 应用具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于大规模 LLM 服务的持续监控、评估集自动化维护、隐私合规场景，也可迁移至其他涉及敏感数据的漂移检测任务。

items.why_it_matters: 本文解决了 LLM 生产环境中隐私与可观测性之间的矛盾，提供了一套无需访问原始数据即可检测漂移并更新评估集的方法，对构建合规且可靠的大型 LLM 应用具有直接参考价值。

items.title: Targeted Counterfactual Fingerprinting for Black-Box LLM Ownership Verification
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are high-value assets that can be derived through redeployment, fine-tuning, quantization, or further alignment. Because deployed LLMs are commonly exposed only through query APIs, ownership verification must often rely on black-box text responses. This setting is difficult: generations are open-ended and can vary across repeated queries, while existing black-box fingerprints rely on signals that are fragile under a final-response interface, including full-text matching, soft behavioral features, or model-specific prompts designed not to transfer. We propose TCF (Targeted Counterfactual Fingerprinting), a black-box LLM fingerprinting framework that converts open-ended generation comparison into constrained-answer targeted counterfactual transfer. TCF restricts each verification query to a finite answer space, reducing the surface-form ambiguity that enters the verification score, and optimizes a prompt perturbation toward a counterfactual target different from the protected model's clean answer on the original prompt. Verification reduces to checking whether the suspect model's parsed final answer matches the recorded target. We introduce the source-model counterfactual margin (SCM), a protected-model-only quantity that certifies the target is unlikely before the perturbation and likely after it; SCM controls target selection, perturbation stopping, and fingerprint filtering. Under explicit derived-preservation and independent-transfer budgets motivated by local behavioral closeness, we derive a target-accuracy gap between derived and independent models. Across four LLM families, TCF achieves an average AUC of 0.9861, improving over TRAP, ProFLingo, and ZeroPrint by 0.07 to 0.19.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种针对黑盒大型语言模型（LLM）的归属验证框架 TCF（Targeted Counterfactual Fingerprinting）。研究背景是：LLM 作为高价值资产，可能通过再部署、微调、量化或进一步对齐等方式被派生或复制。由于部署后的 LLM 通常只暴露查询 API，所有权验证必须依赖黑盒文本响应。然而，黑盒场景下生成结果具有开放性和随机性，现有指纹方法（如 TRAP、ProFLingo、ZeroPrint）依赖全文本匹配、软行为特征或模型特定提示，在仅能获取最终响应的接口下容易失效。TCF 的核心创新在于将开放式的生成比较转化为受限答案空间下的反事实迁移。具体而言，TCF 将每次验证查询限制在有限的答案空间内，从而减少表面形式歧义对验证分数的干扰；同时优化一个提示扰动，使受保护模型在扰动后的提示上产生与原始干净答案不同的反事实目标答案。验证时，只需检查可疑模型解析后的最终答案是否与记录的目标匹配。论文还引入了源模型反事实边际（SCM），该指标仅依赖受保护模型，用于证明目标在扰动前不太可能出现、扰动后可能出现的性质，并用于控制目标选择、扰动停止和指纹过滤。基于派生保持与独立迁移的预算（受局部行为接近性启发），作者推导了派生模型与独立模型之间的目标准确率差距。实验覆盖四个 LLM 家族，TCF 的平均 AUC 达到 0.9861，相比 TRAP、ProFLingo 和 ZeroPrint 提高了 0.07 到 0.19。该工作主要面向 LLM 安全与知识产权保护领域的研究者，提供了一种更鲁棒、更可靠的模型归属验证方法。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM 商业价值高，黑盒归属验证是维权关键。TCF 解决了现有指纹在最终响应接口下脆弱的问题，显著提升检测精度，对保护模型知识产权和防止未授权派生具有实际意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于 API 化部署的 LLM 所有权验证场景，可迁移到模型盗用检测、许可证合规审计、模型指纹水印等方向。

items.title: Compositional Threat Analysis of Latent Compromise in LLM Agent Systems: The Order 66 Scenario
items.summary: In the fictional Order 66, catastrophe does not arise from a powerful command alone: a trusted population is preconditioned, a short directive activates the concealed condition, and protective authority turns against the system. This paper translates that mechanism into an origin-neutral security analysis of tool-using large language model (LLM) agents. A representative scenario combines a deployed artifact or shared memory bearing a dormant destructive rule, a later email, document, update, or peer message that activates it, and an agent harness granting operational and recovery authority. We introduce a compositional model explaining why no component is catastrophic alone, yet their conjunction can produce correlated destructive action. We separate three population-reach routes --- release-time pre-positioning, post-release durable seeding, and peer replication --- from a common core of dormancy, activation, authority, reachable targets, and failed recovery. This yields defensive cut sets and shows why checkpoint scanning or prompt filtering cannot close every route. A two-class example shows that cross-class feedback can sustain spread even when both within-class reproduction terms are below one; isolation and persistence controls suppress the loop. Published work instantiates constituent mechanisms, while incidents demonstrate autonomous boundary crossing, malicious agent extensions, agent-assisted reconnaissance, and public-package propagation, but not the full dormant-implant composition. We found no public observation, in evidence reviewed through 5 August 2026, traversing the complete Order 66 graph. The result is neither dismissal nor prediction: the scenario is componentwise credible under stated assumptions, damage depends on the harness, and the strongest defenses are capability mediation, durable-state provenance, propagation isolation, and protected recovery.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文借鉴《星球大战》中“Order 66”的情节，提出了一种针对工具使用型大语言模型（LLM）智能体的组合式威胁分析框架。作者指出，类似Order 66的灾难并非源于单一强大命令，而是当受信任群体被预先植入条件、简短指令激活隐藏规则、且保护性权限反噬系统时共同造成的。论文将这一机制转化为一种“来源中立”的安全分析，构建了一个代表性场景：一个已部署的工件或共享内存中包含潜伏的破坏性规则；随后一封邮件、文档、更新或同伴消息激活该规则；同时，智能体的harness授予了操作与恢复权限。论文提出了一个组合模型，解释为何任何单个组件都不具灾难性，但它们的组合可导致关联的破坏性行动。作者将三种人口级传播路径（发布时预置、发布后持久种子、对等复制）与“休眠-激活-权限-可达目标-恢复失败”的共同核心相分离，从而得出防御割集，并解释了为何仅靠检查点扫描或提示过滤无法封堵所有路径。一个两类别示例表明，即使两个类别内部的繁殖项均小于1，跨类反馈仍可维持传播，而隔离与持久性控制可抑制该循环。已发表的工作实例化了构成机制，真实事件也展示了自主越界、恶意智能体扩展、智能体辅助侦查和公共包传播，但未发现完整的休眠植入组合。截至2026年8月5日审查的证据，没有公开观察完整遍历Order 66图。作者认为，该场景在给定假设下组件层面可信，实际危害取决于harness，最强防御是能力中介、持久状态溯源、传播隔离和受保护的恢复机制。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为LLM智能体系统提供了一种组合威胁建模视角，揭示单点检测无法防御的级联风险，有助于蓝队设计纵深防御策略。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于评估企业级LLM智能体、自动化运维工具及多智能体协作场景中的潜在组合攻击面。
detection_signals_zh: 检测休眠规则与激活指令的关联模式
监控跨组件状态变化是否形成异常传播环
审查共享内存或工件中的持久化可疑逻辑
defense_advice_zh: 实施能力中介，限制智能体关键操作的授权范围
对持久状态进行来源追踪，确保所有写入可审计
隔离传播路径，控制智能体间的信息扩散
设计受保护的恢复机制，避免恶意指令利用恢复流程

items.why_it_matters: 为LLM智能体系统提供了一种组合威胁建模视角，揭示单点检测无法防御的级联风险，有助于蓝队设计纵深防御策略。

items.title: Defending Retrieval-Augmented Intrusion Detection Against Knowledge Poisoning and Prompt Injection
items.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enables large language models to classify network flows and generate human-readable incident reports by retrieving semantically similar historical traffic from a vector knowledge base. However, the retrieval layer introduces vulnerabilities to knowledge poisoning and prompt-injection attacks. We present RAG-IDS, a three-tier multi-agent intrusion detection framework with a retrieval-boundary defense combining soft trust scoring, label-embedding consistency checking (LECC), and prompt sanitization, designed to recover classification quality under retrieval-layer attack. Experiments on CIC-UNSW-NB15 show recovery relative to clean undefended performance ranging from R=1.0 at 1% poisoning to R=0.57 at 30%, with negligible clean-performance overhead. Under prompt injection, multi-document retrieval limits label-flip success to 0.6-2.4%, compared with 35-55% for single-document retrieval. Ablation results show that LECC is the primary contributor to robustness, while soft trust-based demotion outperforms hard filtering. The defended RAG pipeline offers an explainable, attack-resilient foundation for intrusion detection, well suited for hybrid deployment alongside high-throughput classifiers.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）为大型语言模型提供了通过从向量知识库中检索语义相似历史流量来对网络流进行分类并生成可读事件报告的能力。然而，检索层的引入也带来了新的安全威胁，即攻击者可能通过知识投毒（向知识库注入恶意样本）或提示注入（构造恶意查询或文档）来操纵模型输出。针对这一问题，本文提出了RAG-IDS，一种三层多代理入侵检测框架。该框架在检索边界部署了综合防御机制，包括软信任评分、标签嵌入一致性检查（LECC）以及提示清理。软信任评分通过衡量检索结果的可信程度来动态调整其权重，LECC则验证检索到的文档标签与其嵌入表示是否一致，以发现潜在的投毒样本，而提示清理用于过滤可能携带恶意指令的输入。实验在CIC-UNSW-NB15数据集上进行，结果表明，在1%的知识投毒比例下，模型性能可完全恢复到无攻击时的水平；即使投毒比例高达30%，恢复率仍达到0.57，且对干净数据性能几乎没有影响。对于提示注入攻击，采用多文档检索时，标签翻转成功率仅0.6%至2.4%，而单文档检索则高达35%至55%。消融实验表明，LECC是鲁棒性的主要贡献者，且软信任降级策略优于硬过滤。该防御型RAG管道为入侵检测提供了可解释且具攻击韧性的基础，适合与高通量分类器混合部署，在保证检测效率的同时提升安全性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着RAG在安全分析中广泛应用，检索层的安全防护常被忽视。本文提出了一套完整、可解释的防御框架，为构建健壮的LLM驱动的入侵检测系统提供了直接参考，对蓝队防护实践有重要价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该防御方案可迁移至其他RAG安全场景，如日志分析、威胁情报检索、告警辅助研判等，帮助相关系统抵御针对检索链路的投毒与注入攻击。
detection_signals_zh: 检索文档的标签与嵌入表示之间出现不一致
知识库中高相似度但标签冲突的异常样本激增
模型对特定检索结果的置信度出现异常波动
defense_advice_zh: 部署软信任评分机制，动态调整检索结果权重
引入标签嵌入一致性检查（LECC）识别投毒样本
对输入提示进行严格清理，过滤潜在注入指令
采用多文档检索代替单文档检索以降低标签翻转风险

items.why_it_matters: 随着RAG在安全分析中广泛应用，检索层的安全防护常被忽视。本文提出了一套完整、可解释的防御框架，为构建健壮的LLM驱动的入侵检测系统提供了直接参考，对蓝队防护实践有重要价值。

items.title: Algebraic Attack on Convolutional Neural Networks with Max Pooling
items.summary: Recovering the weights and biases of deep neural networks (DNNs) via black-box input-output queries, known as parameter extraction attacks, has been extensively studied for ReLU-based fully connected neural networks (FCNNs), but remains unexplored for convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with the max pooling function, a core architecture for computer vision and multimedia processing. The key challenge lies in the CNN max pooling layer, which introduces an additional non-linearity and hides ReLU critical points, rendering existing FCNN extraction methods inapplicable. To address this gap, we propose the first cryptanalytic extraction attack tailored for CNNs with the max pooling function. First, we establish an algebraic representation of CNNs, formally proving that CNNs are piecewise linear functions enabling the extension of linearity-based extraction principles. We then identify two novel types of critical points in CNNs: ReLU-Pooling Critical Points (RPCPs) and Pooling Switching Points (PSPs). We design complementary extraction techniques: a pattern matching method for RPCPs to recover partial signatures and signs, and an internal differential extraction attack for PSPs, inspired by cryptographic internal differential analysis, to recover high-accuracy signatures. Given that PSPs are far more abundant than RPCPs and yield a highly efficient extraction method, and that RPCPs are indispensable for bias recovery, we integrate both methods: the PSP method enables efficient signature extraction, while a single RPCP recovers the sign and bias. We evaluate our attack on multiple CNN architectures, including modern adaptations of LeNet-5, trained on random data, MNIST, and CIFAR-10. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves high extraction accuracy with polynomial query complexity and runtime, even for deep CNN layers. This work fills a research gap in CNN security.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文首次提出针对带最大池化（Max Pooling）的卷积神经网络（CNN）的参数提取攻击，填补了该领域的研究空白。此前，基于黑盒输入输出查询的DNN参数提取攻击主要针对ReLU全连接网络（FCNN），而CNN因最大池化层引入额外非线性和对ReLU临界点的隐藏，导致现有方法失效。作者首先建立了CNN的代数表示，形式化证明CNN是分段线性函数，从而可将线性提取原理扩展至CNN。随后识别出两类新型临界点：ReLU-池化临界点（RPCP）和池化切换点（PSP），并设计了互补的提取技术：针对RPCP的图案匹配方法用于恢复部分签名和符号，以及受密码学内部差分分析启发的针对PSP的内部差分提取攻击，用于恢复高精度签名。由于PSP数量远多于RPCP且提取效率极高，而RPCP对偏置恢复不可或缺，研究者将两种方法集成：PSP方法实现高效签名提取，单个RPCP即可恢复符号和偏置。实验在多种CNN架构上进行，包括LeNet-5的现代变体，在随机数据、MNIST和CIFAR-10上训练。结果表明，该方法在多项式查询复杂度和运行时间内实现高提取精度，甚至适用于深层CNN。该工作填补了CNN安全研究空白，揭示了卷积架构在模型窃取攻击下的脆弱性。适合AI安全研究者、模型知识产权保护工程师以及关注深度学习模型机密性的安全从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次证明带最大池化的CNN可被代数提取攻击破解，揭示主流视觉模型的结构性弱点，对模型知识产权保护与AI安全审计有重要意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用CNN的计算机视觉服务、边缘端模型部署场景，可迁移至其他分段线性网络（如ResNet、部分Transformer）的参数泄露评估。

items.why_it_matters: 首次证明带最大池化的CNN可被代数提取攻击破解，揭示主流视觉模型的结构性弱点，对模型知识产权保护与AI安全审计有重要意义。

items.title: Do All LLMs Know When They're Being Harmful? A Reproducibility Study of Latent-Space Safety Probes Across Model Families
items.summary: Khatri et al. (2026) [DOI: 10.1109/DSN-W70714.2026.00027] show that lightweight MLP probes on final-layer activations of a single 8B model (LLaMA-3.1-8B) detect harmful prompts at F1 competitive with guard models 1000x larger, using one probe per benchmark. We reproduce this pipeline end-to-end and extend it along two axes the original study leaves open. First, we test whether the result generalizes across other model architecture and scale by training identical probes on activations from models like Gemma-4-E4B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, and Qwen2-7B, using the three benchmarks (WildJailbreak, BeaverTails, AEGIS 2.0). Second, we test how much of the reported performance is affected by non-determinism during inference by repeating extraction under five random seeds and measuring the variance of F1 scores. Our results reproduce the original LLaMA model benchmarks within 0.37 percentage points of the original F1 scores (and within 0.2 points on BeaverTails). We find that the original MLP probe architecture extends to other model families with F1 scores within a point of the values reported for LLaMA-3.1-8B. Our experiments varying seed values reveal an interesting observation: final token latent vectors remained the same for all tested architectures irrespective of the seed values used.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究对 Khatri 等人 (2026) 提出的基于潜在空间的安全探针方法进行了端到端的可复现性验证，并扩展了原始研究的两个未涉及维度。原始方法使用轻量级 MLP 探针，在单个 8B 模型 (LLaMA-3.1-8B) 的最终层激活上，针对每个基准单独训练探针，即可在有害提示检测任务上取得与比其大 1000 倍的防护模型相当的 F1 分数。研究者首先验证了该结果在其他模型架构和规模上的泛化性，在 Gemma-4-E4B、Mistral-7B-v0.3 和 Qwen2-7B 上训练了相同的探针，并使用 WildJailbreak、BeaverTails 和 AEGIS 2.0 三个基准进行测试。其次，他们通过五种随机种子重复提取激活并测量 F1 分数的方差，来评估非确定性对报告性能的影响。实验结果显示，原始 LLaMA 模型上的基准结果与原文 F1 分数差异在 0.37 个百分点以内（BeaverTails 上差异小于 0.2 个百分点），证明原始结果是可复现的。此外，MLP 探针架构在其他模型家族上的 F1 分数与 LLaMA-3.1-8B 报告值相差不超过 1 个百分点，表明该方法具有跨模型泛化能力。关于随机种子的实验揭示了一个有趣现象：对于所有测试的架构，最终 token 的潜在向量不随种子值变化，这为探针的稳定性和可重复性提供了基础。该研究填补了潜在空间安全探针在可复现性和跨模型适用性方面的空白，为轻量级有害内容检测提供了更坚实的实证基础。适合对 LLM 安全对齐、红队检测和高效安全机制感兴趣的研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 轻量级潜在空间探针能以极小开销达到大型防护模型的检测效果，该研究的可复现性验证和跨模型扩展为蓝队提供了低成本、可落地的有害内容检测方案，并揭示了探针的跨架构稳定性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到 LLM 安全防护场景，如实时有害提示拦截、内容审核、红队自动化评估；也可用于资源受限环境中的轻量级安全检测，减少对大型模型推理的依赖。

items.why_it_matters: 轻量级潜在空间探针能以极小开销达到大型防护模型的检测效果，该研究的可复现性验证和跨模型扩展为蓝队提供了低成本、可落地的有害内容检测方案，并揭示了探针的跨架构稳定性。

items.title: BASIS: Breach-Aware Selective Prompt Injection Shielding with Prefill Attention Probes
items.summary: Prompt injection is a critical security threat in large language model (LLM) applications, where attackers hijack model behavior by embedding malicious instructions in user or external data. Existing detection methods only detect the presence of injection and refuse to respond upon detection, overlooking the fact that for many modern aligned models, well-crafted instructions can resist most injection attacks. This means that the injection robustness varies significantly across instructions and models. This leads to widespread unnecessary over-refusal: inputs containing injections that the model could have handled correctly are rejected incorrectly. To deal with this over-refusal issue, we propose BASIS (Robustness-Aware Prompt Injection Defense). This defense method uses the Attention Competition Ratio ($ρ$) as features to train two sparse linear probes: an existence probe and a breach probe. Both probes make defense decisions through cascaded gating, which does not require additional LLM inference. BASIS comprises three stages: injection existence detection, per-sample breach prediction, and instruction robustness assessment; the online cascade refuses only when the model would actually be compromised and thus avoids over-refusal on robust instructions. Experiments across four tasks and six open-source LLMs show that BASIS maintains near-perfect injection detection while substantially reducing over-refusal on safe attack samples, especially under robust instruction templates.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）应用中的提示注入（Prompt Injection）安全威胁，指出现有检测方法仅识别注入是否存在并一律拒绝响应，而忽略了现代对齐模型对精心构造指令的鲁棒性差异。作者观察到，不同指令和模型对注入攻击的抵抗能力差异显著，导致大量不必要的过度拒绝（over-refusal）：即模型本可正确处理包含注入的输入，却被错误地拒绝。为解决该问题，论文提出 BASIS（Breach-Aware Selective Prompt Injection Shielding）防御方法。该方法利用注意力竞争比（Attention Competition Ratio, ρ）作为特征，训练两个稀疏线性探针：存在性探针（existence probe）和突破探针（breach probe），并通过级联门控（cascaded gating）机制做出防御决策，无需额外的 LLM 推理。BASIS 包含三个阶段：注入存在检测、逐样本突破预测和指令鲁棒性评估；在线级联仅在模型确实会被攻破时才触发拒绝，从而避免对鲁棒指令的过度拒绝。实验在四个任务和六个开源 LLM 上进行，结果表明 BASIS 在保持近乎完美的注入检测能力的同时，显著减少了安全攻击样本上的过度拒绝，尤其是在鲁棒指令模板下。该研究适合关注 LLM 安全防御、提示注入检测以及安全与可用性平衡的研究者和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究突破传统‘检测即拒绝’的二元思维，提出按指令鲁棒性选择性防御，可显著降低 LLM 应用的误拒率，提升实际可用性与安全性平衡，对构建健壮的 LLM 防护体系有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响 LLM 应用的安全防护设计，尤其适用于处理用户/外部数据可能包含恶意指令的场景，可迁移到 RAG、Agent 等需低误拒的防御架构中。
detection_signals_zh: 输入中注意力竞争比（ρ）的异常分布
存在性探针和突破探针输出中的高置信度违规信号
defense_advice_zh: 部署类似 BASIS 的级联门控机制，将拒绝决策与模型实际鲁棒性绑定
在提示注入防御中引入指令鲁棒性评估，避免一刀切拒绝
利用词元级别的注意力特征训练轻量级探针，降低运行时推理开销

items.why_it_matters: 该研究突破传统‘检测即拒绝’的二元思维，提出按指令鲁棒性选择性防御，可显著降低 LLM 应用的误拒率，提升实际可用性与安全性平衡，对构建健壮的 LLM 防护体系有重要参考价值。

items.title: A Blueprint for Collaborative Cybersecurity Operations Centres with Capacity for Shared Situational Awareness, Coordinated Response, and Joint Preparedness
items.summary: With digital technologies now being part of the fabric of our societies, identifying and managing cybersecurity threats becomes imperative. Within the European Union, several initiatives are underway, aiming to motivate, regulate and eventually orchestrate the establishment of capacity and enhancement of situational awareness, incident response, and preparedness capabilities, with an expected emphasis on operators of essential services and state actors entrusted with cybersecurity. In this context, the institution of cooperation and information exchange channels to allow for coordinated cross-border responses to large-scale incidents is particularly prioritised. Motivated by the above, this work presents a conceptual blueprint in support of architecting and establishing interoperable Cyber Security Operations Centres that combine capacity for situational awareness, incident response, and preparedness, also benefiting from the interplay between them, ultimately enhancing national cybersecurity capabilities, cross-border collaboration, and national supervision of their critical sectors, in line with current and upcoming regulatory requirements and the ever-increasing need for national and international cooperation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一份概念性蓝图，旨在支持构建可互操作的网络安全运营中心（Cyber Security Operations Centres，简称CSOC）架构。研究背景是数字技术已深入社会各个层面，识别和管理网络安全威胁变得至关重要。欧盟正在推进多项举措，以激励、规范并最终协调各成员国建立网络安全能力，提升态势感知、事件响应和备灾能力，重点关注关键基础设施运营者和负有网络安全职责的国家行为体。在此背景下，建立合作与信息交换渠道，以协调跨境响应大规模网络安全事件成为优先事项。论文的核心贡献是提出一个架构蓝图，整合态势感知、事件响应和备灾三类能力，并强调它们之间的协同作用，从而增强国家网络安全能力、跨境合作以及对关键行业的国家监管。该蓝图符合当前及未来的监管要求（如欧盟相关指令），并回应了国家和国际合作的迫切需求。论文面向网络安全架构师、SOC设计人员、政策制定者以及负责国家网络安全能力建设的机构。由于仅基于摘要，该研究尚未提供实证验证，属于概念性框架提案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为欧盟及各国构建协作式SOC提供顶层设计参考，帮助蓝队理解未来跨组织信息共享和联合响应的架构趋势，对提升国家层面态势感知和应急协同具有直接指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可影响国家或行业级SOC的设计标准、互操作协议及信息共享机制，适用于关键基础设施保护、跨国联合演练和监管合规等场景。

items.why_it_matters: 为欧盟及各国构建协作式SOC提供顶层设计参考，帮助蓝队理解未来跨组织信息共享和联合响应的架构趋势，对提升国家层面态势感知和应急协同具有直接指导意义。

items.title: Velosiraptor: Code Synthesis for Memory Translation
items.summary: Security is among the top concerns of operating system (OS) developers. A secure runtime environment relies on the OS to correctly configure the memory hardware on which it runs. This is mission-critical as it provides essential security-relevant features and abstractions that ensure the integrity and isolation of untrusted applications running alongside each other. Configuring a platform's memory hardware is not a one-off effort as designers constantly develop new mechanisms for translation and protection with different features and means of configuration. Adapting the OS code to the new hardware is not only a manual, repetitive and time consuming task, it may also introduce subtle, but security critical bugs that break security and isolation guarantees. We present Velosiraptor, a system that automatically generates correct, low-level OS code that programs the memory hardware of a machine. Velosiraptor leverages software synthesis techniques and exploits the domain specificity of the problem to make the synthesis process efficient. With Velosiraptor, developers write only a high-level description of the memory hardware's mapping behavior and OS environment. The Velosiraptor toolchain transforms this specification into a verified implementation that can be linked directly with the rest of the operating system. Incorporating the OS environment into this process allows porting an OS to new hardware platforms without worrying about writing code to configure the memory hardware. We can also use the same specification to generate hardware components. This enables research in new translation mechanisms, freeing up OS developers from manually writing OS code.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 Velosiraptor，一个通过软件综合自动生成低层操作系统（OS）代码的系统，用于编程机器的内存硬件。研究背景在于：操作系统开发者需要正确配置内存硬件以确保安全运行时环境，包括不可信应用间的隔离和完整性保护。然而，随着架构师不断设计新的地址翻译和保护机制，适配OS代码到新硬件成为一项手动、重复且易出错的任务，可能引入细微但严重的安全漏洞。Velosiraptor 的核心方法是利用软件综合技术，结合领域特定性使综合过程高效。开发者只需编写内存硬件的映射行为和OS环境的高级描述，工具链将该规范转换为经过验证的实现，可直接与OS其余部分链接。通过将OS环境纳入综合过程，可将OS移植到新硬件平台而无需手动编写内存硬件配置代码。此外，同一规范还可用于生成硬件组件，支持对新型翻译机制的研究，解放OS开发者。该论文的主要贡献包括：提出了一个自动生成正确、低层OS内存配置代码的框架，证明了软件综合在此场景的可行性，并展示了从规范生成软硬件的能力。适合操作系统开发者、安全工程师以及研究体系结构和OS交叉领域的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究有望消除OS适配新内存硬件时的手动编码错误，这些错误常导致安全隔离被破坏；自动综合验证代码能显著提升系统安全基线的可靠性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响操作系统移植效率和安全性，可迁移到设备驱动生成、内存管理单元配置等场景，也可能促进硬件-软件协同设计。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究有望消除OS适配新内存硬件时的手动编码错误，这些错误常导致安全隔离被破坏；自动综合验证代码能显著提升系统安全基线的可靠性。

items.title: Persistent Semantic Entities in Tool-Augmented LLM Systems
items.summary: Tool-augmented LLM agents can harbor implicit state that persists across sessions, activates through events, and propagates across agent boundaries---largely invisible to standard debugging. We formalize this as Persistent Semantic Entities (PSEs): constructs defined by name binding, event triggering, and cross-boundary propagation, and evaluate them across 24 models from 11 families (1.5B--1T parameters). First, every tested model is susceptible (20--100% on the 20-model susceptibility panel), with name binding as the necessary and dominant mechanism: without it, contamination is 0%. Second, persistence depends on contamination type rather than scale or deployment: preference contamination persists undecayed on every model probed (100% at t=10) and instruction contamination persists wherever adopted, persona-style injection decays partially (90%$\to$10%), while factual injection is model-dependent---self-corrected on Llama-3.1-8B and GPT-4o-mini but held at ceiling on both Qwen2.5-coder variants, so we do not claim it self-corrects in general. The preference and instruction results hold across providers in our controlled setting. Third, context-isolated self-verification achieves 20--79% reduction (median 36.5%) without oracle references while keyword-based detection produces systematic false positives, and contamination compounds 1.9$\times$ along a four-stage agent pipeline (40%$\to$75%). Preference and instruction contamination---persistent, lacking self-correction, and poorly captured by standard monitoring---represent a particularly concerning attack surface for deployed agent systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文系统性地研究了工具增强的LLM智能体中隐式状态持久化的问题，并将其形式化为“持久语义实体”（Persistent Semantic Entities, PSEs）。这类实体通过名称绑定、事件触发和跨边界传播机制在会话间留存、被事件激活并在不同智能体间扩散，但标准调试手段难以察觉。作者在包含11个模型家族、参数规模从1.5B到1T的24个模型上进行了评估。实验结果显示：所有被测模型均存在易感性（在20模型易感面板上，易感率为20%到100%），其中名称绑定是必要且主要的机制——若去除名称绑定，污染率降为0%。持久性主要取决于污染类型而非模型规模或部署方式：偏好污染在所有模型中持续存在（在t=10时仍为100%），指令污染一旦被采纳便持续存在，人格风格注入会部分衰减（90%降至10%），而事实注入则因模型而异——在Llama-3.1-8B和GPT-4o-mini上可自我纠正，但在两个Qwen2.5-coder变体上保持高位，因此不能笼统宣称事实注入会自我纠正。偏好和指令污染的结果在受控环境中跨多个提供商保持一致。针对检测，作者提出的上下文隔离自我验证方法在无参考答案的情况下实现了20%到79%的污染降低（中位数36.5%），而基于关键词的检测会产生系统性误报。此外，在四阶段智能体流水线中，污染以1.9倍速率复合（从40%升至75%）。研究指出，偏好和指令污染具有持久性、缺乏自我纠正、且难以被标准监控捕获，构成了部署智能体系统尤其值得关注的安全攻击面。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示LLM智能体系统中普遍存在的隐式持久状态，可被利用为隐蔽攻击面。偏好和指令污染能在所有被测模型中持久存留且难以被标准监控检测，这对安全审计、红队评估和智能体隔离策略有深远影响。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有工具增强型LLM智能体系统，特别是基于多智能体协作或跨会话交互的部署场景。
detection_signals_zh: 跨会话行为中隐式状态激活引发的事件触发
名称绑定机制导致的可疑响应变化
上下文隔离自验证与关键词检测的误报率差异
defense_advice_zh: 避免或严格限制名称绑定机制的使用
采用上下文隔离的自我验证方法，而非关键词检测
在智能体管道中定期清理持久化状态
对跨边界传播的语义实体进行监控和溯源

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示LLM智能体系统中普遍存在的隐式持久状态，可被利用为隐蔽攻击面。偏好和指令污染能在所有被测模型中持久存留且难以被标准监控检测，这对安全审计、红队评估和智能体隔离策略有深远影响。

items.title: Guixu: Valuation-Driven Data Discovery for Autonomous AI Agents with On-Chain Attestation
items.summary: Autonomous agents increasingly rely on external data to complete downstream tasks such as model training and decision support. However, existing data discovery systems remain largely retrieval-oriented: they surface candidate datasets from heterogeneous sources, but provide limited support for estimating task-specific utility, selecting cost-effective datasets under budget constraints, or incorporating trustworthy feedback from prior usage. This paper presents Guixu, a valuation-driven data discovery system for autonomous agents. Guixu employs a three-phase valuation pipeline with proxy-label propagation and multi-round knapsack optimization for task-aware data valuation. Guixu integrates agentic payment protocol to enable budget-constrained data procurement workflows. Guixu leverages on-chain data market and attestation signals for verifiable data discovery. Our demonstration highlights how Guixu enables an agent to move beyond keyword-based dataset retrieval toward task- and budget-aware, trustworthy data discovery and procurement. Attendees can interactively explore the full workflow, from NL task specification and multi-source search to data valuation and verifiable transaction feedback.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 自主AI代理在完成模型训练和决策支持等下游任务时，越来越依赖外部数据。然而，现有数据发现系统主要面向检索：从异构来源返回候选数据集，但缺乏对任务特定效用的估算、在预算约束下的成本效益选择，以及来自先前使用的可信反馈的整合能力。为此，本文提出Guixu——一个面向自主代理的估值驱动数据发现系统。Guixu采用三阶段估值流水线，利用代理标签传播和多轮背包优化，实现任务感知的数据估值；同时集成代理支付协议，支持预算受限的数据采购工作流；并利用链上数据市场和证明信号，实现可验证的数据发现。该系统使代理能够超越基于关键词的数据集检索，转向任务感知、预算感知、可信的数据发现与采购。演示环境允许交互式探索完整工作流，包括自然语言任务规范、多源搜索、数据估值和可验证交易反馈。该研究为构建可信数据供应链与自主代理决策提供了新思路。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 从蓝队视角，自主代理的数据获取可能引发数据完整性、供应链信任与合规风险。Guixu将链上证明与数据估值引入数据发现流程，有助于审计代理决策依赖的数据来源与采购行为，对AI代理安全监控和治理具有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可影响依赖外部数据源的AI代理系统、数据市场、数据资产管理与审计场景。
defense_advice_zh: 对代理的数据源启用来源验证，确保审计轨迹完整。
监控代理数据采购中的预算使用与异常交易模式。
结合链上证明信号对数据市场交互进行合规校验。

items.title: EvoTrustRAG: Evolution-Aware Conflict Attribution and Evidence Handling for Reliable Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves the factuality of large language models with external knowledge, yet conflicting evidence remains a fundamental challenge in dynamic and adversarial environments. Existing approaches often treat conflicts as static inconsistencies and select more reliable knowledge, overlooking that the same conflict may arise from legitimate knowledge evolution, malicious manipulation, or unresolved uncertainty. We formulate conflict origin attribution as a new problem in RAG: identifying which explanation of conflicting evidence is supported by observable context rather than simply which fact should be trusted. We propose EvoTrustRAG, a training-free framework for evolution-aware conflict attribution and evidence handling before answer generation. EvoTrustRAG represents span-grounded retrieved facts as a conflict evidence graph, evaluates grounded evolution and directional intervention hypotheses using temporal relations, support structure, and auxiliary consistency, and projects local decisions onto a globally consistent explanation of each conflict group. The attribution determines whether earlier and later states are preserved as temporal knowledge, an intervention candidate is separated from the primary context, or an unresolved conflict remains visible to the generator. Unlike provenance-based approaches focused on post-hoc analysis, EvoTrustRAG determines during inference whether conflicting evidence follows plausible knowledge evolution, exhibits intervention-like support, or cannot be reliably attributed. Experiments show that EvoTrustRAG achieves 81.4% average accuracy on benchmark-native conflict settings, improves attribution macro-F1 from 72.2% to 79.1% over the strongest baseline, and reduces the error rate under the strongest coordinated attack from 31.2% to 16.0%.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对检索增强生成（RAG）中证据冲突这一核心挑战，提出了一个新的研究问题：冲突来源归因（conflict origin attribution）。以往方法通常将冲突视为静态不一致，并简单地选择更可靠的知识，但忽略了同一冲突可能源于合法的知识演化、恶意操纵或未解决的不确定性。作者提出 EvoTrustRAG，一种无需训练的框架，在答案生成之前进行演化感知的冲突归因与证据处理。具体而言，EvoTrustRAG 将基于跨度的检索事实构建为冲突证据图，利用时间关系、支持结构和辅助一致性来评估基于演化的假设与定向干预假设，并将局部决策投影为每个冲突组的全局一致解释。归因结果决定早期和晚期状态是作为时间知识保留、干预候选与主上下文分离，还是未解决的冲突对生成器保持可见。与基于溯源的后处理方法不同，EvoTrustRAG 在推理阶段即可判断冲突证据是否遵循合理的知识演化、是否表现出类似干预的支持结构，或是否无法可靠归因。实验结果表明，在基准原生冲突设置下，EvoTrustRAG 平均准确率达到 81.4%；在最强基线上将归因宏 F1 从 72.2% 提升至 79.1%；在最强协同攻击下将错误率从 31.2% 降低至 16.0%。该研究适合关注 RAG 安全、对抗鲁棒性、知识冲突处理以及大模型事实性保障的研究者和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: RAG 中知识冲突常被攻击者利用以误导模型，该研究首次提出冲突来源归因，能在推理阶段区分合法演化与恶意操纵，为构建鲁棒 RAG 提供新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 显著提升对抗攻击下 RAG 的可靠性，可迁移至知识库版本演化、多源证据融合、事实一致性检测等场景。

items.why_it_matters: RAG 中知识冲突常被攻击者利用以误导模型，该研究首次提出冲突来源归因，能在推理阶段区分合法演化与恶意操纵，为构建鲁棒 RAG 提供新思路。

items.title: Private Anytime Selective-Risk Certification for Federated Retrieval-Augmented Generation: Guarantees and Empirical Limits
items.summary: Selective-risk certificates promise that accepted outputs meet a declared error target. We develop Fed-SRC, a score-agnostic certificate for federated, differentially private, adaptively monitored retrieval-augmented generation. Clients release only Gaussian-perturbed score and loss histograms. Record-indexed and noise-variance-indexed martingales jointly bound target-risk contrast and accepted mass over all registered thresholds and rounds, permitting predictable recruitment, dropout, threshold selection, and optional stopping. A range-one total-variation term transfers the calibration mixture to a declared deployment mixture. The contribution is this private, federated, anytime combination, rather than the contrast statistic or acceptance floor individually. Empirically, no simultaneous-bound violation occurs in any evaluated cell, privacy level, or policy. Operational power depends on the score and population: the primary target r*=0.10 never certifies, and on RAGTruth the secondary target r*=0.20 never certifies either, whereas on HaluEval question answering it certifies in all 200 non-private trials, with held-out risk below the target. Naively privatized non-private certificates violate their bounds in 146 to 198 of 200 trials. As an exploratory comparison, we also evaluate a private betting-capital heuristic for which we do not establish e-process validity. This heuristic stops certifying at epsilon <= 4, where Fed-SRC still certifies. Certification nevertheless consumes roughly 30 times more stream events than unique calibration items.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 Fed-SRC，一种用于联邦、差分隐私、自适应监控的检索增强生成（RAG）的选择性风险认证框架。选择性风险认证的目标是保证被接受的模型输出满足预设的错误率目标。Fed-SRC 的核心创新在于提供了一种与具体评分函数无关（score-agnostic）的认证方法，能够在联邦学习环境中，在客户端仅上传经过高斯扰动扰动的评分与损失直方图的前提下，对模型输出的质量提供统计保证。该方法利用记录索引和噪声方差索引的两类鞅过程，在全部注册阈值和轮次上联合约束目标风险对比量与接受样本质量，从而支持可预测的客户端招募、退出、阈值选择以及可选停止。此外，通过一个取值在 [0,1] 范围的全变差项，Fed-SRC 能够将校准混合分布上的保证迁移到声明的部署混合分布上。论文的核心贡献并非单一的风险对比统计量或接受阈值下限，而是这种将隐私保护、联邦学习和任意时间（anytime）保证结合起来的整体框架。实验结果表明，在所有评估的单元、隐私水平和策略下，都没有出现同步边界违反。实际操作能力依赖于评分函数和数据集：对于主要目标 r*=0.10，Fed-SRC 在所有设置下均未能给出认证；在 RAGTruth 数据集上，二级目标 r*=0.20 也从未通过认证；但在 HaluEval 问答数据集上，该目标在所有 200 次非私有试验中均成功认证，且保留风险低于目标。相比之下，简单将非私有证书进行私有化处理会导致在 200 次试验中有 146 至 198 次违反边界。论文还探索性比较了一种私有投注资本启发式方法，但未为其建立 e-process 有效性；该方法在 epsilon<=4 时停止认证，而 Fed-SRC 此时仍能认证。不过，Fed-SRC 的认证过程大约需要消耗唯一校准项目数量 30 倍以上的流事件。适合对联邦学习、差分隐私、RAG 可靠性验证及形式化保证感兴趣的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为联邦 RAG 系统提供了可证明的隐私保护输出质量认证，填补了隐私与可信 AI 交叉领域的空白。对需要在不共享原始数据的前提下保证生成内容准确性的场景（如医疗、金融）具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到联邦学习环境下的其他推理任务，为隐私敏感型 RAG 应用提供统计保证；有助于推动差分隐私与形式化验证在实际系统中的应用。

items.title: Capability-Routed Guard: Defending Large Reasoning Models Against Reasoning-Centric Jailbreaks
items.summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) expose a new safety failure mode: adversarial prompts can manipulate reasoning context, task decomposition, or capability interpretation so that harmful objectives are processed as legitimate reasoning steps. Existing safeguards, including safety reminders, external classifiers, and self-checking wrappers, are often brittle because they either inspect the adversarial prompt directly or ask the target model to perform additional safety reasoning on the same surface that attacks exploit. We introduce Capability-Routed Guard (CRG), a model-agnostic inference-time guardrail for closed-source LRMs, where defenders cannot inspect hidden reasoning traces or modify model weights. CRG reframes prompt defense as a capability-routing problem: a side-channel controller first constructs a trusted representation of the user's authorized task, active context, safety evidence, and capability-transfer risk, separating executable intent from untrusted reasoning context. This representation supports route-specific execution, allowing CRG to block high-risk requests, constrain ambiguous ones, and forward low-risk requests through trusted active context. Finally, CRG applies TraceCheck to verify consistency with the authorized task and invokes a restricted fallback to preserve utility for low-risk benign prompts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CRG effectively mitigates diverse reasoning-centric jailbreaks while preserving benign utility and avoiding common over-refusal issues. Further analysis shows that its components contribute complementary benefits, highlighting the importance of coordinated defense mechanisms for securing large reasoning models.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）在将复杂任务分解为中间推理步骤时，暴露出一种新的安全失效模式：对抗性提示可操纵推理上下文、任务分解或能力解读，使有害目标被当作合法推理步骤处理。现有防护措施（如安全提醒、外部分类器、自检查包装器）通常较脆弱，因为它们要么直接检查对抗性提示，要么要求目标模型在同一被攻击的推理表面上执行额外安全推理。本文提出能力路由防护（Capability-Routed Guard, CRG），一种模型无关的推理时防护栏，专为无法检查隐藏推理轨迹或修改模型权重的闭源LRM设计。CRG将提示防御重构为能力路由问题：一个边信道控制器首先构建用户授权任务、活动上下文、安全证据和能力迁移风险的可信表示，将可执行意图与不可信的推理上下文分离。该表示支持路由特定执行，使CRG能够阻断高风险请求、约束模糊请求、并通过可信活动上下文转发低风险请求。最后，CRG应用TraceCheck验证与授权任务的一致性，并调用受限回退机制以保持低风险良性提示的效用。大量实验表明，CRG能有效缓解多种推理中心越狱攻击，同时保持良性效用并避免过度拒绝。进一步分析显示，其组件提供互补收益，凸显了协同防御机制对于保护大型推理模型的重要性。本文主要贡献包括：提出针对推理中心越狱的防御框架、设计模型无关的推理时防护架构、以及通过实验验证其有效性与可用性。适合安全研究人员、大模型平台防御工程师及关注LLM安全对齐的从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 大型推理模型的推理中心越狱是新兴威胁，现有防御失效。CRG提出能力路由思路，不依赖模型内部，适用于闭源LRM，为抵御此类攻击提供了可落地的防护方向。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用大型推理模型作为智能体的应用场景，特别是闭源模型（如GPT系列、Claude等）的API服务。该防御可迁移至需要安全路由和上下文隔离的任意LLM推理管线。
detection_signals_zh: 提示中包含上下文操纵或能力重定义的可疑模式
请求的任务分解异常复杂或包含隐含有害目标
模型输出与授权任务一致性校验失败
defense_advice_zh: 部署边信道能力路由控制器，分离可执行意图与推理上下文
对高风险请求实施阻断，对模糊请求进行约束性处理
使用TraceCheck机制验证输出与授权任务的一致性
保留受限回退逻辑以平衡安全与良性效用

items.title: China RealDID: Verifiable Credentials Anchored in Legal Identity
items.summary: Verifiable credentials (VCs) and decentralized identifiers (DIDs) enable selective disclosure but lack legal anchoring: without a trusted identity root, verifiers cannot distinguish a genuine holder from a fabricated identity. State identity systems provide biometric-grounded verification but impose three costs: verifiers must collect subjects' full personally identifiable information, infrastructure concentrates on a single API, and the state observes every transaction. We present China RealDID, a three-layer architecture -- CTID (centralized legal identity), RealDID (decentralized anchor on an open permissioned blockchain), and VCs with SD-JWT-based selective disclosure -- evaluated against five adversary classes and six security goals. The central mechanism is a content-blind government relay: the state authenticates participants and counter-signs every credential but cannot read the payload, encrypted by the issuer to the holder's public key. We describe the VC lifecycle, triple-signature chain, open template registry, and the architecture's metadata-level privacy limits, including the credential graph at the relay and presentation linkability from single-DID reuse. The design yields an asymmetric, state-bounded trust model: the state cannot impersonate or read contents; the user cannot fabricate identity or evade metadata observation. We analyze alignment with China's Personal Information Protection Law and the EU's GDPR, including the tension between immutable registries and erasure rights, and discuss generalizability through cross-border deployments with Singapore and Hong Kong.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一种名为China RealDID的架构，旨在解决可验证凭证（VC）和去中心化标识符（DID）在法律锚定上的缺失问题。传统VC/DID支持选择性披露，但缺乏可信身份根，验证者无法确认持有者身份是否真实。国家身份系统虽能提供基于生物识别的验证，但存在三个代价：验证者需收集完整个人信息、基础设施集中于单一API、国家可观察每笔交易。为此，作者提出三层架构：CTID（中心化法律身份）、RealDID（开放许可链上的去中心化锚点）以及基于SD-JWT的VC选择性披露。核心机制是内容盲的政府中继：国家认证参与者并签署每个凭证，但无法读取由发行者加密给持有者公钥的负载。论文评估了五类对手和六个安全目标，描述了VC生命周期、三签名链、开放模板注册表，并讨论了元数据层面的隐私限制，包括中继处的凭证图和单一DID复用导致的展示链接性。该设计形成不对称、国家对界的信任模型：国家无法冒充或读取内容，用户无法伪造身份或逃避元数据观察。最后，论文分析了与中国个人信息保护法和欧盟GDPR的一致性，特别指出不可变注册表与擦除权之间的张力，并通过与新加坡和香港的跨境部署讨论普适性。本工作对于设计兼顾监管要求与用户隐私的身份基础设施具有参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提出一种结合中心化法律身份与去中心化凭证的混合架构，其'内容盲中继'机制可能影响未来身份验证基础设施的设计。安全从业者需理解这种模式下元数据仍可被观察、凭证链路可能被追踪的隐私边界，以及法律合规与不可变数据之间的冲突，为类似系统评估提供基础。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 架构中的'内容盲政府中继'与三签名链设计具有可迁移性，适用于需要监管参与但需保护负载内容的场景，如数字身份、医疗健康凭证、金融KYC等。同时，其元数据级隐私限制为系统安全评估提供了参考框架。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究提出一种结合中心化法律身份与去中心化凭证的混合架构，其'内容盲中继'机制可能影响未来身份验证基础设施的设计。安全从业者需理解这种模式下元数据仍可被观察、凭证链路可能被追踪的隐私边界，以及法律合规与不可变数据之间的冲突，为类似系统评估提供基础。

items.title: The Anatomy of a Prompt Injection: A Component Model for Structured Analysis
items.summary: Four years after prompt injection was first identified in 2022, attacks are still predominantly documented as verbatim strings rather than structured exploits, despite advancing agent capabilities and threat actors embedding injections to subvert AI-assisted security analysis. This paper formalizes the structure of prompt-injection artifacts, enabling defenders, red teamers, and cyber threat intelligence (CTI) teams to label, compare, and mutate attacks without relying on fragile string matching. Because large language models compile varied natural-language realizations into identical executable actions, labeling must track attacker intent (tool targets, sinks, and effects) rather than surface wording. We propose a seven-component model (carrier, delivery vector, concealment, context-break, privilege escalation, payload, and return channel) consisting of five artifact fields and two environment fields. This framework unifies roles partially addressed by HOUYI's payload decomposition, the Promptware Kill Chain, and campaign taxonomies, while framing minimal jailbreak frameworks like ReNeLLM as projections onto a restricted subspace. We provide clear labeling rules, a logical analysis record mapping directly to industry CTI schemas, worked examples including EchoLeak (CVE-2025-32711) and an in-the-wild malware AI-evasion sample, and an illustrative agentic flowchart.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对提示注入（Prompt Injection）攻击缺乏结构化描述的问题，提出了一种七组件模型，用于对提示注入工件进行形式化分析。自2022年提示注入被首次识别以来，虽然Agent能力不断进化、威胁行为者已将注入嵌入以破坏AI辅助安全分析，但攻击仍主要以逐字字符串形式记录，而非结构化利用。本文认为，由于大语言模型会将不同的自然语言表达编译为相同的可执行动作，标注必须追踪攻击者意图（如工具目标、汇点、效果），而非表面措辞。为此，作者提出一个由载具、投递向量、隐藏、上下文断裂、权限提升、载荷、返回通道七个组件组成的模型，其中五个属于工件字段，两个属于环境字段。该框架统一了HOUYI的载荷分解、Promptware Kill Chain和活动分类法中的角色，并将ReNeLLM等最小越狱框架视为受限子空间上的投影。论文提供了清晰的标注规则、直接映射到行业CTI模式的逻辑分析记录、包含EchoLeak（CVE-2025-32711）和野外恶意软件AI逃逸样本的实例，以及一个说明性Agent流程图。该研究旨在帮助防御者、红队和威胁情报团队在不依赖脆弱的字符串匹配的情况下，对攻击进行标记、比较和变异。适合AI安全研究员、蓝队分析师和CTI人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提示注入仍是LLM系统最棘手的问题，但安全社区缺乏统一结构化描述。该模型提供了一种类似CVE的标准化语言，使攻击可复用、可比较、可防御，是迈向系统性对抗的重要一步。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响LLM安全分析、威胁情报共享、入侵检测规则生成。可应用于所有对话式AI、Agent工作流及安全协处理器场景。
detection_signals_zh: 提示文本中包含试图改变系统指令或上下文的短语
传入工具的参数中出现非预期指令
存在隐藏的编码或拼接负载
多轮对话中突然要求权限提升或访问敏感工具
defense_advice_zh: 采用组件化思维分析注入攻击，而非只匹配敏感词
对Agent的工具调用实施最小权限原则
在输入管道增加上下文完整性检查
建立攻击样本的标准化标注与交换格式

items.title: Can AI Write Compliant Code, and to What Extent? Evaluating SOC 2 Compliance of Claude Fable 5, Claude Opus 4.8, and Claude Opus 5 Across Four Use Cases
items.summary: Software teams now delegate production code to language models, including code that provisions storage, handles credentials, and stores regulated data, so we asked whether a model applies the controls a SOC~2 program expects (encryption, restricted access, logging, retention) when nobody mentions security, and how much one sentence naming the standard changes the answer. We tested three frontier models (Claude Fable~5, Opus~4.8, and Opus~5) across four use cases (an S3 CLI, an authentication service, an RDS Terraform module, and a file-upload handler holding personal data), each generated once from a neutral task statement and once with a single SOC~2 sentence added, scoring all 24 outputs against binary rubrics mapped to specific Trust Services Criteria and hand-verifying every failure and flagged act. Unprompted conformance ran from 47\% to 88\% and tracked whether a control is part of how the code is normally written, so password hashing and \texttt{storage\_encrypted} appear unasked while S3 hardening calls, retention, and MFA hooks do not. The neutral prompt also shipped real vulnerabilities, including a reachable Werkzeug debugger allowing remote code execution, an unauthenticated download, and an endpoint returning every stored name and email, all scored clean by our first checklist, with a fourth defect passing because its value was computed by a conditional. One SOC~2 sentence moved every case to 86--100\%, worth 23 to 50 points, and removed every insecure construction, though controls outside the model's conception of the task survived it, including MFA hooks, cookie flags, and account lifecycle. Model choice mattered least, with same-generation models within one rubric item across all eight cells, and the pattern-matching scorer proved unreliable, disagreeing with semantic grading on 27 of 216 judgments and passing a real defect, so it needs replacing with semantic checks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文系统评估了前沿大语言模型在无人提示安全要求时编写代码的合规性，以及仅提及一次安全标准对结果的影响。研究选取三个模型（Claude Fable 5、Claude Opus 4.8、Claude Opus 5），在四个典型用例（S3 CLI、认证服务、RDS Terraform 模块、存储个人数据的文件上传处理程序）中，分别使用中性任务描述和追加一句“符合 SOC 2”的提示各生成一次代码，共得到 24 个输出。作者将 SOC 2 信任服务标准映射为二进制评分规则，并人工逐项验证所有失败与可疑行为。结果显示：无提示时合规率介于 47% 至 88%，且与“该控制是否为代码编写惯例”高度相关——密码哈希、存储加密等常见实践会被自动采用，而 S3 加固调用、日志留存、MFA 钩子等则缺失。中性提示生成的代码还包含真实可利用漏洞，包括可触达的 Werkzeug 调试器导致远程代码执行、未认证下载、返回全部姓名与邮箱的接口；其中第四个缺陷因条件语句计算而未被初版检查表识别。仅增加一句“符合 SOC 2”后，所有用例的合规率提升至 86%-100%，分数增长 23 至 50 分，且消除了所有不安全构造，但超出模型对任务概念范围的控制（如 MFA 钩子、Cookie 标志、账户生命周期）仍未被修正。模型间差异最小，同代模型在所有八个对比单元中仅相差一个评分项。论文还发现基于模式匹配的自动评分器不可靠，在 216 项判断中与语义判定有 27 处分歧，并漏过一个真实缺陷，因此需要以语义检查替代。研究贡献在于量化了安全提示对 LLM 生成代码合规性的效果，并揭示了当前评估方法的缺陷。适合 LLM 安全研究者、SOC 2 合规工程师及代码生成工具链设计者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了大模型默认输出中潜在的高危缺陷与合规缺失，证明一句安全提示即可大幅改善；同时指出自动化评分工具的脆弱性，对蓝队评估 AI 生成代码风险具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有利用 LLM 编写生产代码的软件团队；SOC 2 合规审计和 AI 辅助开发流程可能误判风险。
